default_policy.review_rule: Only declared public HTTPS hosts may be contacted; user-provided feed and article URLs remain subject to common.is_safe_url and explicit runtime input.

scripts\\common.py.purpose: Call the configured LLM endpoint for structured extraction and text polishing.
scripts\\common.py.custom_url_policy: explicit user configuration only after common.is_safe_url validation

scripts\\content-archiver.py.purpose: Read user-selected RSS/API sources and archive normalized content.
scripts\\content-archiver.py.custom_url_policy: explicit user input only after common.is_safe_url validation

scripts\\platforms_fetcher.py.purpose: Read public Bilibili metadata for the optional metrics workflow.

scripts\\search_backends.py.purpose: Call configured public search and extraction backends.
scripts\\search_backends.py.custom_url_policy: backend-specific and explicit; fetched article URLs are validated by common.is_safe_url
